name: hive-freelance
description: Hive-based freelance marketplace with on-chain escrow

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @hive-freelance/shared && npm run build -w @hive-freelance/db && npm run build -w @hive-freelance/hive && npm run build -w @hive-freelance/provisioner
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,listener -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @hive-freelance/api" "npm run dev -w @hive-freelance/web" "npm run dev -w @hive-freelance/listener"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @hive-freelance/api
scripts.dev:listener: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @hive-freelance/listener
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @hive-freelance/api && npm run build -w @hive-freelance/listener && npm run build -w @hive-freelance/web
